== Notes ==

* Use of the glyph will not prevent skills that [[disable]] the affected spell, e.g. it does not prevent [[Power Block]].

{{bug|It is sometimes possible to be interrupted by a [[Destroyer of Deeds]] using [[Broad Head Arrow]] in [[Glint's Challenge]] or by the [[environment effect]] [[Cathedral Collapse]] in [[Arborstone]] while this glyph is still active.}}

== Trivia ==
* This glyph may have once been known as "Glyph of Gesture", see [https://www.gamespot.com/articles/guild-wars-profile-preview-the-elementalist/1100-6111466/ GameSpot preview of the Elementalist].
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Glyph of Concentration/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
